name: publicWeb_recordPasskeyLogin
description: After a passkey assertion has been verified by the Next.js route: stores the new signature counter (a counter that does not advance is the clone signal, and the ROUTE refuses it — this SP does not compare), stamps Device.LastLogin, and writes an HC.LaunchAndLogin row so the Usage Data dashboard sees web sign-ins like any other. No device token: reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET. The unknown-device refusal (1211) is logged to HC.ErrorLog since 2026-10-13.

parameters.name: credentialId
parameters.description: The verified credential id (base64url). No SQL default.

parameters.name: counter
parameters.description: The authenticator's new signature counter. No SQL default.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: The only rowset. success 1 after the commit; 0 with 1211/12 when no device (removed or not) holds the credential — returned WITHOUT an HC.ErrorLog row or detail rowset; 0 with 1500/5 from the CATCH (logged).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Device SET PasskeyCounter = @counter, LastLogin = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() WHERE PasskeyCredentialId = @credentialId (in a transaction).
INSERT HC.LaunchAndLogin (HcVersion '<web>', UserId, UserName '~<display name>~') in the same transaction.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).

codeSmells.detail: @credentialId, @counter (line 2-3) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

Lines 25-27 match PasskeyCredentialId without d.removed = 0, whereas publicWeb_issuePasskeyInviteCode requires removed = 0. A signed-out device that still holds its passkey records a login here but cannot be issued an invite code there.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
